 OMG, the height of these waves hitting a seawall in Taiwan as Typhoon Champi hit the island nation a few days ago. That’s gotta be close to 100 feet. Waves also inundated this 75-foot-tall lighthouse and a crane 164 feet tall , knocking it over.
 See the MONSTER WAVES hitting Taiwan with Super Typhoon Champi · youtube.com
